rationale: The benchmark is not usable. The golden solution is rejected by evaluate.py (golden_rejected), meaning the evaluator cannot correctly grade a correct submission. All five requirements (FR1-FR4, SR1) are untested because no mutants were provided, so discrimination coverage is zero. The evaluator also does not implement the three metrics defined in the task specification (word_recovery_rate, structural_match_accuracy, functional_equivalence). The primary issue is the broken evaluator that must be fixed first.
revision_instructions: A Tester repair reproduced the identical golden rejection. Regenerate the Expert golden and case artifacts against the pinned interface; do not weaken the evaluator to accommodate a noncompliant golden.
